name: research-workflow
tagline_zh: 一个有意思的技能：research-workflow。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Plan and execute multi-step research, surveys, feasibility studies, and evidence-heavy analyses with adaptive planning, source verification, critic review, and cross-task learning. Use when a request needs multiple dependent investigations or a durable evidence trail; do not use for simple factual questions or small one-step edits.
